notes: Fix: the Smoke Mine now also trips on a sprinting merc, it trips when a merc comes within 2 m of it (was 1.5 m), and walls, floors and level geometry block it, so a merc behind a wall no longer sets it off. Smoke grenades: the cloud is 10% bigger, and so is the area that counts as smoke. The Smoke Mine in the spy's jammer slot (3 charges) is a silent trap, armed 2 s after it lands; untripped, it disappears after 45 s. Everyone in a match needs this build.

addons.title: Smoke grenade buff and smoke mines
